statute: 21 U.S.C. 343(w) (FALCPA of 2004) and FASTER Act of 2021

precautionaryAdvisoryPolicy.substituteProhibition: Precautionary allergen advisory statements (e.g. 'May Contain', 'Produced in a facility that also processes') cannot substitute for required declaration of intentional ingredients in the ingredient list or Contains statement.
precautionaryAdvisoryPolicy.misleadingLabelingConcern: When an ingredient is intentionally present in the recipe (e.g. Almonds, Pecans, Walnuts), including that same allergen in a 'May Contain' advisory is misleading to consumers and requires Legal/QA reconciliation.
